postCardSecret.label: Bridge secret for /api/post-card (in-app only)
postCardSecret.helpText: External GCP callers use a managed App Token (devvit_at_…), not this setting.

catalogUrl.label: Hellfall catalog URL
catalogUrl.helpText: JSON catalog for card-of-the-day (https; must be HTTP-fetch allow-listed). Set via devvit settings set.

officialHcRedditFlair.label: Official HC Reddit flair ID
officialHcRedditFlair.helpText: Flair UUID for COTD and default /post-card flair when omitted. Set via devvit settings set.

cardOfTheDayViaDevvit.label: Card of the day via Devvit
cardOfTheDayViaDevvit.helpText: Scheduler posts HC6 card-of-the-day. Pair with REDDIT_COTD_VIA_DEVVIT=1 on the Discord bot.
